sources.ATLAS_scope: 225 GeV is the observed mass reach on the ATLAS pure-loop line. The light-pole floor, validity of the transfer, and 1 GeV pole-to-step allowance are explicit hypotheses. No public tabular CLs scan down to MZ is incorporated.

scope: At least one full pure higgsino signal template with the same production, lifetime, unobserved neutral degeneracy, pion branching, and bin acceptances. For two copies the explicit experimental exclusion transfers for equal masses and proportional template; independent lower bounds for nonidentical copies require adequate recasting. Finite common pole-to-step offsets separately tested. Releasing the two 8.374 TeV single thresholds gives a bound if both must see the 7.171 TeV active neutral source.
